text:
maya: Quick flag: PR #4321 changed /generate request 'verbosity' from numeric to enum (Low|Medium|High) and made it nullable. Top example and SDK snippets still send numbers. We need a docs sweep for examples + a short migration note.

sam: On it. Which snippets are pinned in the file? Rust, Python, Go, and curl?

iman: Runtime currently coerces 0/1/2 to strings but that behavior is scheduled for removal in the next minor. Docs must show canonical enum strings, a nullable example (omit field), and a migration mapping.

maya: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 . Please update: generate.md examples, sdk_snippets/* for Rust/Python/Go, and the top curl sample. Also add a one-paragraph migration note in CHANGELOG.md.

sam: Plan: replace numeric examples with 'verbosity: "Medium"', add Rust snippet using Verbosity::High, update Python/Go to use "Low"/"Medium" strings, add curl with JSON string value. Add a one-liner sed/jq for bulk replace mapping 0->Low,1->Medium,2->High. Will open patch shortly.

ivan: Also add a deprecation banner on the /generate API ref and a note in the runtime changelog that coercion will be removed in 14 days. Deploy-bot: please schedule a short compatibility window.

deploy-bot: Noted. Scheduling 2-week migration window and announcement cadence.

docs-bot: Checklist added to the PR: update examples (Rust/Python/Go/curl), add migration blurb to CHANGELOG.md, add API deprecation banner, and run docs build.

sam: Pushing changes now. Will request reviews from @maya and @ivan when CI completes.

maya: Thanks. I will merge after docs CI and approvals. :thumbsup:
